name: api-message
description: One API message, request or reply: a status or address line, the fields as labelled boxes, and optionally the raw text (e.g. JSON) as it travels.

kicker.description: small label on top, e.g. `Request · the order form`

line.description: the first line in mono: an address (`GET https://…`) or a status (`200 OK`)

tone.description: colours the first line: ok for success, warn for an error

wide.description: the box takes a whole row

raw.description: the message as raw text, shown under the boxes in mono

rawLabel.description: small label above the raw text
